entries.06b4aab58162e73a: A holding company of a group that conducts pharmaceutical research and development and contract manufacturing, sale of raw materials, sale of cosmetic and food ingredients, and manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals and surface treatment chemicals.
entries.102df4ecdcad42ac: This business contracts out CMC research, development and manufacturing for pharmaceuticals, and manufactures and sells pharmaceutical raw materials.
entries.115d736810aefe5f: This division saw growth in new acquisitions of priority sales products and development products, a product group developed jointly with suppliers, and demand for high value-added in-house products increased.
entries.2d0c1d58cf198549: This division handles manufacturing plants for printed wiring boards and similar products.
entries.3148e5bac81a3ff6: This division improves production capacity in formulation manufacturing through the introduction of two-shift operation for topical preparation manufacturing, and is expanding the handling of high value-added contract products in API manufacturing.
entries.38875827219370c9: In the CMC field, this division conducts sales activities targeting new drug makers, venture companies and generic drug makers, and also focuses on orders related to MicroED (microcrystal electron diffraction) and nitrosamines.
entries.390e58acfdf8889f: This division handles neonatal and pediatric ventilators and other products. Although the share of its main products has expanded, the neonatal medical device market is shrinking due to the decline in births.
entries.45eaefd7105a43f4: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, mainly concerned with regional revitalization. It plans and sells its own brands, undertakes operational work for the Astena Group, and invests in businesses contributing to the SDGs, mainly in the Noto region. The main companies are Astena Minerva Co., Ltd., NAIA Co., Ltd., Astena Heartful Co., Ltd., and Okunoto SDGs Investment Limited Liability Partnership.
entries.4b16724cb81136fa: This business manufactures and sells prescription drugs, OTC drugs, pharmaceutical raw materials and fine chemicals. Iwaki Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. handles it.
entries.4f4d3792f7122d7f: In the CMC field, this division conducts sales activities targeting new drug makers, venture companies and generic drug makers, and also focuses on orders related to MicroED (microcrystal electron diffraction) and nitrosamines. In the peptide and nucleic acid fields, it handles process development projects for medium-molecule active pharmaceutical ingredients.
entries.5155acdc6c841bb8: This business contracts out CMC research, development and manufacturing for pharmaceuticals, and manufactures and sells pharmaceutical raw materials. It also develops the peptide synthesis method “Molecular Hiving™,” develops manufacturing processes for peptide active pharmaceutical ingredients and transfers the technology, contract-manufactures the same ingredients, and licenses the technology. The main companies are Spera Pharma Co., Ltd., Spera Nexus Co., Ltd., JITSUBO Co., Ltd., and Iwaki Pharmaceutical Sakura Plant Co., Ltd.
entries.6281e2e9d192947f: This division saw increased sales of the medical-institution-exclusive cosmetics “NAVISION DR” series and the “illsera” series, which it began handling in December 2024.
entries.6491cbd29d0d9087: This division handles neonatal and pediatric ventilators and other products.
entries.653fb9778698c33b: This business manufactures and sells chemicals for the electronics industry, surface treatment chemicals and chemical products, sells raw materials for surface treatment chemicals, and manufactures and sells manufacturing plants for printed wiring boards and similar products. Meltex Co., Ltd., Tokai Meltex Co., Ltd., Tokyo Kakoki Co., Ltd. and overseas Meltex Group companies are responsible for it.
entries.8d7b413e3e322a62: This division handles manufacturing plants for printed wiring boards and similar products. Although it focused on repair and maintenance projects and parts sales in addition to equipment sales, orders for equipment fell sharply because customers' capital investment had run its course.
entries.93d0ef31027c50fe: This business sells OTC drugs, cosmetic raw materials and functional food ingredients, and manufactures and sells cosmetics and health foods. It also plans, develops and sells various supplements and other health foods, smoking-cessation products such as Kin'en Paipo, and other health-related products, and provides import agency services for cosmetics. The main companies are Iwaki Co., Ltd., Apros Co., Ltd., Maruman H&B Co., Ltd., Ainzu Labo Co., Ltd., Ikeda Sangyo Co., Ltd., Ikeda Bussan Co., Ltd., Innovation Co., Ltd., and Ikeda Corporation of America.
entries.a8e4ba51049292a5: This division handles functional food ingredients and other products, and sales remained steady as demand for existing delivered products increased.
entries.ac8fe0743cf20edb: This division sells high value-added imported active pharmaceutical ingredients and pharmaceutical intermediates for new drugs, and works to strengthen supply chain functions such as inventory and logistics efficiency.
entries.e096ced28104116c: This business manufactures and sells chemicals for the electronics industry, surface treatment chemicals and chemical products, sells raw materials for surface treatment chemicals, and manufactures and sells manufacturing plants for printed wiring boards and similar products.
entries.e5fca298ec12cb9b: This division saw sales of existing cosmetics rise through mail order, and in imported cosmetics sales increased significantly, partly due to the launch of new products in the Korean cosmetics 'Torriden' series.
entries.e98e8627b0436e53: This division handles high value-added products such as chemicals for fine wiring formation, plating chemicals for passive components, and chemicals for semiconductor electrode formation, and in chemicals for electronic components, sales were steady due to growing demand in Taiwan and China.
entries.f1284b5efa7f0d44: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, mainly concerned with regional revitalization.
entries.f7e8815c4fb06ece: This business sells OTC drugs, cosmetic raw materials and functional food ingredients, and manufactures and sells cosmetics and health foods.
entries.fadaac7cd55005b0: This business manufactures and sells prescription drugs, OTC drugs, pharmaceutical raw materials and fine chemicals.
entries.fafb46e7e286c78f: Sales of the generic drug “Luliconazole ‘Iwaki’” grew, and for products whose sales of the originator drug were announced to be discontinued, sales of “Clobetasol Propionate Ester ‘Iwaki’” and others increased.
